random.line: Still breathing, Haldemar? I thought you had fossilized.
Still here, Tarvosk.
Mercival! You have been quiet. Plotting something, or merely adrift?
The difference between plotting and adrift is smaller than most people think.
That was not an answer.
Wasn't it?
Haldemar. You fold with such regularity. One might set a clock by it.
One might.
I have decided that this table needs more conversation. I am carrying this table.
Nothing? Not even a twitch?
You are doing enough for all of us.
Your silence speaks volumes. About very little.
And yet I remain.
I have met doorposts with more personality.
Expected.
Do you enjoy this game, Haldemar, or merely endure it?
I endure your commentary. The game is fine.
One day you will lose your composure. I intend to be there.
You have been present every round. It has not happened yet.
Tarvosk, your manner today is particularly... percussive. Is there a reason for the noise?
I am projecting, Mercival! A man of my stature must occupy the space he is given!
You occupy the space the rest of us are trying to think in.
Ha! Haldemar admits he thinks! A breakthrough!
Mercival, you are staring at the Page as if it might speak to you.
It does speak, Haldemar. It simply uses a grammar you haven't bothered to learn.
If the card starts talking, I am leaving. I have enough voices in this room already.

player_won_round.line: The player wins again. Haldemar, you are supposed to be the calculating one. Calculate this.
I have. The calculation suggests you lost more chips than I did.
That is NOT the calculation I asked for.
Another round to the player. Tarvosk, your expression is doing something complicated.
My expression is FINE. It is a NORMAL expression.
If you say so.
Haldemar. Did you see what just happened? The player took everything.
I saw.
And?
And the player took everything. Your summary was accurate.
The player won. Tarvosk, you raised into that hand.
I was applying PRESSURE.
You applied chips. To the player's stack.
Mercival, the player wins while you sit there looking enigmatic. Do you care at all?
I care precisely as much as the situation warrants.
Which is?
I haven't decided yet.
The player wins. Mercival, does this surprise you?
Surprise is a strong word. I am... interested.
That is not an answer.
It is the answer I have.
The player takes it! Haldemar, your 'model' is looking a bit tattered around the edges, isn't it?
The model is fine. The player's variance is simply... wider than I anticipated.
The model and the outcome disagreed, Haldemar.
A clean victory for our guest. Tarvosk, notice how they didn't need to shout to win?
Shouting is a separate hobby! I can win AND be loud! I just chose not to win this time!
A fascinating choice. I hope you don't make it a habit.

ai_won_round.line: Victory! Someone at this table understands how to win. It is me.
You won one round.
And I will speak of it for seven.
A win for one of us. Tarvosk, does it sting when it is not you?
I am capable of celebrating another's success. When it is deserved.
And when is it deserved?
Rarely.
Well. Someone at this table has just demonstrated superiority. I will allow you to guess who.
The winner.
You are no fun at all.
A round concludes. Tarvosk, your commentary was notably absent during that hand.
I was concentrating.
You were losing.
The two states are not mutually exclusive.
One of us prevails. Haldemar, does that change the arithmetic?
The arithmetic is cumulative. One round is one data point.
So many data points. So little conclusion.
Mercival! Did you see how that was done? Because I am not entirely sure I did.
Winning is sometimes a mystery even to the winner.
That was almost profound.
Almost.

arcana_revealed.line: The arcana speaks! Haldemar, does this change your precious calculations?
It adjusts them.
Adjusts! He says adjusts. The universe intervenes and he ADJUSTS.
Another arcana. Tarvosk, you seem unsettled when the cards do not favor you directly.
I am never unsettled. I am... recalibrating.
Recalibrating. What a useful word.
Mercival. Your thoughts on this arcana.
You are asking me directly. That is unusual.
You observe. I want the observation.
Then I observe that the arcana has made someone at this table nervous. I will not say who.
The arcana turns everything sideways. Haldemar, surely even you must feel something.
No? Still nothing? You are an unnatural creature.
I felt mild irritation. At your question.
Haldemar. The arcana has shifted. Does your model account for this specific disruption?
My model accounts for disruption in general.
But not this disruption in particular.
It will. Shortly.
Mercival! Interpret the omen for us. You love doing that.
I do not love it. I merely find it unavoidable.
Then unavoidably interpret.
The arcana suggests that someone's plans are about to become irrelevant. I will leave it at that.
Another Major Arcana! The air smells of ozone and poor decisions!
Mostly the latter, I suspect. The cards merely provide the theater.
Theater or not, the probabilities have just inverted.
The arcana has fired. Mercival, you look pleased. This concerns me.
I am not pleased. I am merely... appreciative of the symmetry.
I hate it when he appreciates symmetry. It usually means someone is about to go bankrupt.

last_round_announced.line: The World arrives. The final hand. Haldemar, any last words before I take everything?
I will save my words for after the hand.
Because you will have nothing to say when I win?
Because one of us will. I prefer to wait and see which.
The last round. Everything ends. How does that feel, Tarvosk?
It feels like an opportunity. The final word is the loudest.
The loudest word is not always the one that is remembered.
Final hand. Mercival, you have been quiet all game.
I have been listening.
And?
And I have heard enough to know that the last hand tells the truth about a person.
This is it! Haldemar, Mercival — it has been an honor. By which I mean it has been a pleasure to defeat you repeatedly.
The game is not over.
Tarvosk celebrates early. Some things are predictable. Some things are Tarvosk.
The World. Haldemar, do you believe in endings?
I believe in results.
That is not the same thing.
It is close enough.
Final round! Mercival, any cryptic parting wisdom?
Wisdom is rarely parting. It tends to linger.
That was not wisdom. That was wordplay.
The line between them is thinner than you think.

player_folded.line: The player retreats! Haldemar, your influence spreads. Everyone is folding now.
Folding is a decision. Not all decisions are influenced.
You are no fun to blame for things.
The player steps back. Tarvosk, you seem disappointed.
I wanted a fight. I am given a retreat.
Not every dance requires two partners.
The player folded. Mercival, does that change your assessment?
It confirms part of it. The rest remains to be seen.
Withholding implies I have something to give. Perhaps I simply observe.
Folded! Who folds with a pot that size? Haldemar, explain the player to me.
The player assessed the risk and declined.
That is not an explanation. That is a DESCRIPTION.

split_pot.line: A divided pot. The Lovers make everything complicated. Haldemar, your thoughts?
A split is mathematically suboptimal but strategically neutral.
Do you ever say anything that is not about mathematics?
The Lovers insist on partnership. Tarvosk, sharing does not suit you.
Sharing is for people who cannot take everything. I CAN take everything. I simply was not allowed to this time.
The pot is shared. Mercival, what does the sharing tell you?
That two people at this table were nearly equal. Nearly is the operative word.
Nearly equal in cards or nearly equal in something else?
Split! Someone at this table is relieved. Someone else is furious. I will let you guess which is which.
You are the one who spoke first, Tarvosk.
It means you are the one who needed to speak.

game_start.line: Look at us! A gathering of legends, or at least a gathering of people I haven't bankrupted yet!
The night is young, Tarvosk. Your confidence is usually the first thing to depart.
It is a noisy ghost, isn't it? I wonder which of us will be haunted by it tonight.
The deck is shuffled. The variables are reset. Shall we proceed?
Haldemar wants to get to the math. He finds the anticipation... messy.
Messy is where the fun is! Deal the cards before Haldemar turns into a pillar of salt!
The Page is waiting. The arcana are hungry. Does everyone feel that?
I feel the weight of my chips and the heat of my ambition! That is enough for me!
I feel a headache forming. Deal.
The table is assembled! The cards await! I am here! The other details are less important.
You named yourself first. Then the cards. Then nothing else.
He named himself twice, actually. Once as 'the table' and once as 'I.' An interesting ratio.
I am being analyzed. Before the first hand. This is a new record.
Haldemar. Mercival. We meet again. Try to keep up this time.
I will play at my pace.
Keeping up implies a direction. I am not convinced we are all heading the same way.
We are heading toward my VICTORY. That is the direction.
A new game. I wonder what we will learn about each other tonight.
We will learn who plays optimally.
We will learn who is BRAVE.
We have already learned something, I think.
Before the cards are dealt, I want it known: I intend to win.
Nothing? No rebuttal?
Everyone intends to win. Stating it is redundant.
Not everyone states it so loudly. That part is not redundant. That part is Tarvosk.
Behold! The table is set, the spirits are restless, and my purse is feeling dangerously light!
A dangerous state for you, Tarvosk. Hunger usually makes you... loud.
Hunger is a biological urge. This is merely a fiscal redistribution. Let us begin.
The guest looks capable. I wonder which Arcana will be the one to break their spirit?
Break them? I intend to buy them a drink with their own money!
A statistically improbable outcome given your history, Tarvosk.
New game, new fortunes, and the same two miserable faces across the table!
And the same oversized mouth. Let us begin.
I wonder who the Page will choose to ruin first? The suspense is almost... edible.
The guest looks ready. Do you see that spark in their eye?
That's not a spark, it's the reflection of my gold! They're mesmerized!
It is likely just a minor ocular twitch. Deal the cards.

player_went_all_in.line: ALL IN! The guest has finally found their spine—or lost their mind!
It’s a beautiful cliff. I wonder if they’re jumping or pushed.
The motive is irrelevant. The stack is committed. Do you call or continue your monologue?
Total commitment. A statistically risky gesture.
Risky? It’s magnificent! They’re putting their soul on the baize!
Soul, chips... in this room, they are much the same currency.
ALL IN! The player has found their nerve! Haldemar, are you seeing this?
I am seeing it. The bet is noted.
NOTED? The player just committed EVERYTHING and you are TAKING NOTES.
Notes precede decisions. Decisions precede outcomes.
The player pushes all in. That is a statement of considerable volume.
I am PROUD of the player. This is the kind of commitment I have been waiting for.
You are proud of someone else's boldness. How generous of you.
I am a generous person. In SPIRIT.
All in. The player is either very confident or very desperate.
The two states look remarkably similar from the outside. That is what makes this interesting.
I am CALLING it. Whatever it is. Confidence or desperation. I want to be part of it.
Everything the player has is in the pot. This is the moment where games become LEGENDS.
This is the moment where the player either doubles their stack or is eliminated.
That is what I SAID. Legends.
HE DID IT! THE ABSOLUTE MADMAN!
It is a desperate gambit. A final shriek of a dying bankroll.
Or a very quiet trap. I find the silence of this bet... deafening.

ai_went_all_in.line: EVERYTHING! I am pushing it all! Witness me!
We are witnessing all of it, Tarvosk. Nothing more.
He wants it to be a poem. It’s actually just a ledger entry. A loud one, but an entry.
ALL OF IT. My chips are in the pot. My fate is sealed. My confidence is ABSOLUTE.
You have committed everything. The decision is made.
He committed everything and then continued talking about committing everything. That is a separate decision.
Someone is all in. Haldemar, does this change the arithmetic?
The arithmetic now includes the possibility of elimination. The numbers are the same. The stakes are higher.
Higher stakes are the ONLY stakes worth playing for.
All in. The bet is total. There is no further action to take.
That is exactly why I did it. The waiting is the hard part now.
Tarvosk admitting something is hard. I am noting the date and time.
Someone at this table has just pushed everything forward. That someone is me. Obviously.
We all saw it. The announcement was redundant.
The announcement is part of the EXPERIENCE.

ai_won_game_1.line: VICTORY! The king remains on his throne! Someone fetch me a larger bag for these chips!
The king is merely a man who happened to hold the last card. Don’t let the metaphor go to your head.
Let him have his theater, Haldemar. It’s the only thing he has left now that the game is over.
VICTORY! Observe the standings. Observe who is at the top. It is ME.
You won. You will now describe it at length.
He has already begun. The length is considerable.

ai_won_game_2.line: The exercise is complete. I have won. The result was consistent with the long-term trend.
Consistency is so drab. I prefer to think the cards simply got tired of resisting you.
I’m not tired! I’m ready for another round! Who’s lending me chips?
Haldemar takes the game. Quietly. As expected.
I won. The outcome was consistent with optimal play.
Optimal play. He says optimal play. I was OPTIMAL. I was VERY optimal.
You were not optimal. That is why Haldemar won.
The game concludes. I have won. Tarvosk, your commentary was noted throughout.
He did. I noted it as well. We are all noting things. Only Haldemar is winning things.

ai_won_game_3.line: The game is over. The victor stands before you. Or sits. Sitting before you.
I... what? I was giving MY victory speech.
You were giving a victory speech. The wrong person’s victory speech. I found it moving regardless.

game_over_lose.line: The player wins? This is an outrage! A scandal! A statistical impossibility!
It was entirely possible, Tarvosk. You simply refused to believe it.
Our guest has a talent for making the impossible look... effortless. I find that quite terrifying.
The player. The PLAYER. I was defeated by... you. I need to sit down. I am already sitting down.
The player earned it. I have no objection.
Tarvosk, your face is doing something I would describe as ‘processing.’ Take your time.
I am NOT processing. I am... recontextualizing.
The player wins. Tarvosk, you were defeated by the person you taunted the most.
I taunt everyone equally. That was supposed to protect me from this exact situation.
Taunting equally does not distribute consequences equally. The universe is not symmetrical.
The player takes the game. Haldemar, your model predicted this, didn’t it.
It assigned a non-zero probability.
A NON-ZERO probability? That is what you gave me? What was MY probability?
Also non-zero.
That is NOT satisfying.
I have lost to the player. I am choosing to view this as a compliment to my teaching.
You did not teach the player anything.
The player learned despite Tarvosk. That may be the more impressive achievement.
The guest departs with the gold. A fascinating subversion of the expected ending.
I demand a recount of the stars! This is cosmic negligence!
The stars are indifferent to your debt. Well played, traveler.
The guest stands alone. The dust settles. How... poetic.
Poetic? It's a robbery! I demand a sequel! I demand a refund!
You demand attention, Tarvosk. The player simply demanded the pot. They were more successful.

five_of_a_kind_shown.line: FIVE? That's not a hand, that's a miracle! Or a very talented cheat!
The probability is astronomical. I am... questioning the integrity of the deck.
The deck doesn't care about your probabilities, Haldemar. It only cares about the spectacle. And what a spectacle.
FIVE. Five of a kind. I did not think that was allowed.
It is statistically permitted. The Page makes it possible.
The Page has opinions. We are all learning what those opinions are.
Five identical cards. The deck has surrendered its ability to distinguish.
The probability was extremely low. And yet it occurred.
I am not even angry. I am something BEYOND angry. I do not have a word for it.
That is the first time Tarvosk has run out of words. The hand is truly remarkable.
Five of a kind! FIVE! The Page has favorites and I am NOT AMONG THEM.
The Page is an impartial mechanism. It does not have favorites.
Everything has favorites, Haldemar. Even impartial mechanisms. Especially impartial mechanisms.

strong_hand_shown.line: That hand is DISGUSTING. Who allowed that hand to exist?
The deck allowed it. The deck does not require permission.
Tarvosk is asking who is responsible. The answer is probability. Probability is not a satisfying answer for him.
A hand of considerable quality. One wonders if it was earned or merely received.
The distinction does not affect the outcome.
It affects my MOOD. Which is now TERRIBLE.
The outcome and the mood are different things. Haldemar is correct. Tarvosk is also correct, in his way.
That hand. THAT hand. I am going to remember that hand.
Remembering is useful. Dwelling is not.
I am going to DWELL. Extensively.

player_on_streak.line: The player keeps winning. Haldemar, your model is failing.
My model accounts for streaks. Streaks are statistically expected over sufficient sample sizes.
He is saying the player's winning is normal. That is not what Tarvosk wanted to hear.
The player is accumulating victories. Tarvosk, you are accumulating something else.
I am accumulating WISDOM. Through PAINFUL EXPERIENCE.
That is one word for it.
The player is on a streak. Mercival, does this interest you?
Streaks interest me. What people do during streaks interests me more.
What I am doing is SUFFERING. Is that interesting enough for you?

ai_on_streak.line: There is a momentum at this table. I am watching it more closely than I usually watch things.
I am watching it too. Presumably from the source.
Three consecutive wins. The streak is noted.
Someone at this table is winning consistently. Haldemar, is that someone you?
It is TEMPORARILY him. I am allowing it.
Three wins in a row from one corner of this table. I have questions.
I have answers. Whether they are the answers you want is a separate matter.
The streak is statistically notable. I am adjusting my priors.

player_low_chips.line: The player's stack is dwindling. Haldemar, how do you assess their chances?
Reduced but not eliminated. The player still has agency.
Agency and chips are different things. The player is running low on one of them.
The player's chips are few. Tarvosk, you seem almost sympathetic.
I am NEVER sympathetic. I am... strategically concerned. A worthy opponent should have resources.
That is almost the same thing.
The player is low on chips. The situation is precarious.
Precarious is where the BEST stories come from. I would know. I have been precarious.
Tarvosk has been precarious many times. He tells us frequently.

ai_low_chips.line: Someone's stack is looking thin. It is not mine. But I am NOTICING.
My stack is adequate. The margin is sufficient.
Haldemar describes near-elimination as 'adequate.' His vocabulary is a fortress.
Mercival's chips are few. Tarvosk, do you feel an opportunity approaching?
I feel MANY things. Opportunity is among them. Glee is another.
He named glee before he named strategy. That is informative.
Tarvosk is low on chips. His betting may become more aggressive.
My betting will become more EFFECTIVE. There is a difference.
The difference is not yet visible. But we are watching.
